I'm standing in an endless maze of mirrors. The reflection repeats every movement, but something is wrong. It smiles when I don't smile. Whispers: "You'll never get out." I run, but the mirrors multiply, reflecting again and again. Suddenly I notice that one of the reflections is standing still. It turns and says: "I'm real. You're just a dream." The mirrors begin to crack, black liquid flows out of the cracks. It fills the maze, rising higher and higher. My feet stick to the floor. The last thing I see is the reflection waving goodbye.

I go down into the dungeon. The walls are covered with strange symbols that glow with a dim green light. The air smells of dampness and rot. I hear footsteps behind me. I turn around - no one. But shadows appear on the walls, moving on their own. One of them whispers: "You shouldn't have come here." I run, but the corridor becomes narrower. At the end is a door. I open it and see... myself, sitting in the corner and repeating: "You're already here." The walls begin to close in, I feel a stone grip squeezing my body.

I'm standing on the shore of a black lake. The water is still, like glass. Suddenly, hands appear from the depths - hundreds of hands, reaching out to me. I try to move away, but my feet are stuck to the ground. The hands grab me, drag me into the water. I scream, but there is no voice. Water fills my lungs, I see faces - the faces of those I lost. They whisper: "You're next." I try to break free, but the hands pull me deeper. The last thing I see is my reflection, smiling from the depths.

I'm lying in bed. The room is dark, only the moonlight breaks through the curtains. The air is heavy, as if someone is breathing nearby. I hear a rustling sound. Quiet at first, then louder. It comes from under the bed. I freeze. My heart is beating so loudly that it seems to be heard throughout the whole house. The rustling turns into a scratching sound. Something is scraping the floor, slowly, methodically. A hand sticks out from under the bed. It is thin, almost a skeleton, but the skin on it is damp, shiny. The fingers are too long, with black nails that scratch the floor. The hand reaches for my leg. I want to jerk, but I can't. The fingers clasp my ankle. Their touch is icy, sticky. I feel how they squeeze, dig into the skin. A voice comes from under the bed. It sounds like a whisper, but I feel it his whole body: “You know we’re here. You’ve always known.” Another hand. Then another. There are too many of them. They crawl over me, cling to the blanket, to the sheet. Their fingers slide over my skin, leaving sticky marks. “You can’t run away,” they whisper in chorus. “We’re always here. We’re always with you.” I feel myself being pulled down. The bed creaks, sags. I fall. The darkness under the bed is bottomless. I fly into it, and the hands keep pulling, pulling, pulling...

I'm standing in an open field. The night is quiet, the stars are bright, but something is wrong. The air is thick, as if charged with electricity. Suddenly I notice a light in the sky. It's moving too fast, too strangely. It's not a plane. It's not a satellite. The light gets brighter, closer. Now I can see a shape - a disk, huge and silent. It hangs right above my head. I feel goosebumps on my skin. Something inside screams: "Run!", but my legs don't obey. A beam of light descends from the UFO. It is bright, almost blinding. Inside the beam I see shadows - they are moving, as if studying something. One of the shadows breaks off and begins to descend towards me. I want to scream, but there is no voice. The shadow is approaching. I see its eyes - huge, black, bottomless. She looks, and I feel how her gaze penetrates the very depths of the mind. Whispers: "You have been chosen." Suddenly the beam of light disappears and the UFO flies away at incredible speed. I am left alone in the field, but I feel that something has changed. My skin is burning, and there is a strange hum in my head.

I'm walking down a deserted street. There's no sun or moon in the sky, just a dim gray light. Suddenly I notice that all the doors of the houses are open. Whispers are coming from them. I come closer and hear: "He's here. He's coming." I run, but the street never ends. Suddenly, a figure comes out of one of the doors. She's dressed in black, her face hidden. She says: "You're late." I try to scream, but there's no voice. The figure disappears, leaving only a shadow behind.

I'm in an old house. The walls are covered with wallpaper that was once bright, but is now faded. The air smells of mold and dust. Suddenly I hear footsteps upstairs. I go up the stairs, but they never end. Suddenly I find myself in a room. There is a mirror on the wall. I come closer and see that the reflection is not moving. It looks at me and says: "You shouldn't have come here." The mirror cracks, black liquid flows out of the cracks.

I'm in a forest. The tree branches creak like bones. In the distance, I can see the light of a fire. I come closer and see a group of people sitting around the fire. They are silent, their faces hidden by hoods. One of them points at me and says, "You're next." Suddenly, the fire goes out, and I feel someone's hands grabbing me. I try to break free, but the hands pull me deeper into the darkness. The last thing I see is the faces of those who were sitting by the fire. They are smiling.

I find myself in an old elevator. It's going up slowly, but the buttons aren't working. Suddenly the elevator stops and the doors open. There's a long corridor in front of me. There are paintings on the walls, but instead of faces, there are blank canvases. I walk down the corridor, and with each painting I feel like something is watching me. Suddenly, one of the paintings starts saying, "You shouldn't have come here." I try to run, but the corridor keeps getting narrower.

I'm in an old amusement park. Everything around looks abandoned, but the carousel is slowly spinning. I come closer and see children sitting on it. Their faces are pale, their eyes are empty. They look at me and say: "You're next." Suddenly, the carousel starts spinning faster. I try to move away, but my feet are stuck to the ground. The children start laughing, their voices are getting louder. The last thing I see is their faces distorted into smiles.

I'm riding on a bus with some soldiers, one of them is about to be initiated into the soldiers and they're explaining how it's going to happen. I don't like the method. We get off the bus, I jump off, another one follows me, I grab him by the neck in mid-air and flip him over, he falls on his neck and breaks it. I say I didn't mean to do it, it was an accident, I need to put his neck back... I skillfully put his neck back...

I find myself in an old house. Everything around me looks familiar, but something is wrong. Suddenly I hear a voice: "You shouldn't have come here." I turn around, but no one is there. Suddenly the walls begin to close in, and I feel a stone grip squeezing my body. I try to break free, but the hands pull me deeper. The last thing I see is my reflection, smiling from the depths.

I'm standing on the edge of a cliff. The wind is blowing in my face, cold and sharp. Below is an endless forest, the trees swaying like waves. Suddenly I feel my body becoming lighter. My legs come off the ground. My arms rise by themselves, like wings. I take off. The air flows around my body like water. The forest under my feet turns into a green sea. Above are clouds, white and fluffy, like cotton wool. I fly through them, drops of moisture settle on my skin. Everything around is quiet, only the noise of the wind in my ears. Suddenly I notice a figure in the distance. It's a bird, huge, with wings like an airplane. It flies towards me. The bird's eyes are like mirrors, the sky is reflected in them. It flies closer, says in a voice that sounds like the whisper of the wind: Fly higher. Where the sky ends, the truth begins. I try to follow it, but my body becomes heavier. The wings disappear. I fall. The forest below approaches with frightening speed. The tree branches reach up like hands ready to catch. At the last moment before the impact I wake up.

I'm standing in a long corridor. The walls are covered in something wet and shiny, as if they were made of leather. The floor is slippery, with puddles of dark liquid on it. The smell is a mixture of blood, rot and chemicals. In the distance, I can hear the hum of machines, but the sound is distorted, as if coming from under water. I walk forward. There are hooks hanging from the walls, and on some of them are pieces of meat. They are moving, as if they are still alive. Suddenly, one of the pieces falls to the floor. It crawls towards me, leaving a bloody trail behind it. A voice from nowhere: This is not meat. These are people. I turn the corner. I see a conveyor belt. On it are bodies. They are taken apart, but still moving. Hands reach up, mouths open, but there is no sound. A figure in a transparent apron stands above the belt. The face is hidden. mask, but the eyes are empty black holes. The figure takes one of the bodies, places it on the table. The knife in its hand gleams. I come closer. The figure turns. It speaks in a voice that sounds like the grinding of metal: You're next. The conveyor belt starts moving faster. Bodies fall to the floor, crawl toward me. Hands grab my legs, pull me forward. I see the table. The knife is already raised. The last thing I feel is the cold metal on my skin.

I'm standing on the stairs. They go up and down, endlessly, without beginning or end. The steps creak under my feet, the sound echoing through the emptiness. The walls around me are covered in cracks, from which a warm, sticky liquid oozes. The smell of iron and mold fills the air. I start to climb. Each step seems higher than the previous one. My legs are getting heavy, but I can't stop. A noise comes from above - a hum, like the work of mechanisms. Suddenly I hear footsteps behind me. I turn around - no one. But the steps behind me begin to disappear, one after another. I run up. The stairs become narrower, the walls close in. Suddenly I see a figure at the top. It stands with its back to me, dressed in a torn cloak. The figure slowly turns. There is no face - only emptiness, like a dark hole. It speaks in a voice that sounds from inside the head: We can't stop. They are already close. The steps under my feet begin crumble. I fall, but instead of falling I find myself on the same stairs. Now it leads down. There is light below, bright and inviting. I run towards it, but the light moves away with every step. The figure appears again, this time ahead. It says: You will never get out. The stairs start spinning like a carousel. Everything around merges into a continuous whirlwind. The last thing I see is a figure waving its hand, as if saying goodbye.

I wake on the narrow platform of a radio tower rising above a solid ocean of clouds. Red warning lights blink beneath my feet, one after another, descending into the mist. The metal mast sways in the wind. A voice crackles from the speaker: 'Do not look down until you hear your name.' I grip the railing, but the bolts begin to unscrew by themselves and float upward like silver insects. Far below, something enormous moves under the clouds, pushing them aside as if they were water. The speaker repeats my name in my own voice. I look down. The tower has no base. It hangs from a single black cable disappearing into the sky. The cable starts to fray. Each snapping strand sounds like a distant scream. When the last strand breaks, the tower does not fall. The clouds rise instead, swallowing the platform, the lights, and finally my hands.

I'm walking through a flooded supermarket at night. Dark water reaches my knees, and shopping carts drift between the aisles. Every checkout scanner beeps at the same time, though the counters are empty. The loudspeaker announces: 'Customer number one, please proceed to the returns desk.' A receipt slides out of a printer and unrolls across the water. It lists things I have lost: a house key, a friend's voice, the memory of my own face. At the end is a total I cannot read. Mannequins in soaked clothes step down from the displays and push carts toward me. Their baskets are filled with clocks, all ticking backward. I run for the exit, but the automatic doors open onto another aisle. The loudspeaker repeats the announcement, closer now. At the returns desk, someone is waiting with my face and an empty bag. It asks for the receipt. When I hand it over, every light in the store goes out, and the water begins to drain through my mouth.

I'm walking down the street, but something's wrong. The sky is beneath my feet, and the earth is above my head. The houses are hanging in the air, their windows are lit, but there's no one inside. The sidewalk under my feet is transparent, and clouds are visible through it. I walk slowly, afraid to stumble. Suddenly I notice people. They are walking in the sky, as if on the ground. Their figures are upside down, but they don't fall. One of them comes closer. The face is familiar, but I can't remember the name. He says: Everything here is not as it seems. He smiles and leaves, dissolving into thin air. I continue walking. Suddenly the earth above my head starts to approach. The houses fall down, but they don't break. They just hang in the air, as if nothing happened. I hear a voice: You can do it too. I try to step up, but my legs don't obey. Suddenly everything around me starts to spin. The sky and the earth change places. I find myself on the roof of one of the houses. Below is the endless sky. I feel my body becoming lighter. I take a step forward and start falling upward.

I'm walking through the park. It's morning, the sun is just starting to rise. The grass is covered with dew, drops are glittering on the leaves of the trees. The air is fresh, it smells of earth and flowers. Birds are chirping in the distance. An old man is sitting on a bench. He is feeding pigeons, throwing them crumbs of bread. Birds are flying in from all sides, their wings rustling in the air. The old man is smiling, but he is not looking in my direction. I pass by a children's playground. The swings are swinging slightly in the wind, although there is no one around. The sand under my feet is soft, leaving footprints. Suddenly I notice a cat. She is sitting under a tree, looking at me, then slowly disappears into the bushes. The road leads to a lake. The water is calm, like a mirror. Leaves are floating on the surface, and a boat is visible in the distance. It is empty, but it is moving slowly, as if someone invisible is pushing it. I sit down on the shore, looking at the water. Everything around seems so quiet and peaceful.

I'm in a small bookstore. The shelves reach to the ceiling, all filled with books. The air smells of old pages and dust. On the floor lies a carpet with a faded pattern, its edges are frayed. I run along a highway jammed with cars. The road leads toward a military barricade, but the convoy has long stopped moving. Car doors hang open. I sit on a wooden dock beside a quiet lake. The water is almost still; only small circles spread around the float. <LINE> <LINE> Beside me stands an old metal tackle box. No one answers. <LINE> <LINE> I wait, shifting from foot to foot, and realize I cannot hold it any longer. <LINE> <LINE> The lock finally clicks. <LINE> <LINE> I slip inside, close the door, barely manage to undo my belt, and sit down. <LINE> <LINE> My stomach releases. <LINE> <LINE> I begin to relieve myself and breathe out calmly for the first time in the entire dream.

Oh my God! This is terrible! Zombies are climbing through windows and doors... I have a kitchen knife in my hands, there is blood everywhere and a sickening smell of rotting flesh... I understand that there is no chance of salvation... now I will meet my death...

A wide panorama of the forest, bright colors, blue and cloudless sky, green grass and flowers, nature awakens from hibernation... it's spring. Nearby, a group of people, they put up tents and light a fire. Suddenly, the entire surface of the earth turned brown, and the sky black. People who had enjoyed the serenity earlier, panicked and ran into the scattered forest. In the distance, from behind the trees, a gray funnel of an impressive size of a tornado is rapidly moving towards us. I, like everyone else, in the hope of shelter, run up the slope, involuntarily catching with my gaze the bright discharges in the sky...

The ceiling in front of my eyes. I'm lying on my back in bed. I'm trying with all my might to move, but I can't, my whole body is frozen. Some kind of slurping sounds at the edge of the bed from my feet. I look in that direction as best I can... And there... A horrible-looking zombie, furiously clinging to my shin with its claws, with a terribly bloody grin, growling, gnaws at my leg, tearing off pieces of meat from my leg with its teeth... I'm trying with all my might to scream to wake up, but nothing works! I can't even scream, I can only make a muffled moan! I wake up from my own scream, in a cold sweat.

I'm standing next to a well of a huge diameter. Water is visible at a considerable depth. I'm telling someone that I'm very afraid of such wells, it always seems that someone can climb out of there and take you with them. A person passes by, touches me and I fall into the well.

I walk around the rooms and hide from strangers. There's a man ahead, checking different nooks and crannies, looking for something. I hide from him, he passes by. I walk on, they tell me that the stranger is nearby. I press myself against the wall, wait, the stranger crawls on, he drags something like a flashlight behind him, he doesn't see me. He climbs into the ventilation. I turn on something and it grinds him up in it. Then I open the lid, find brains there and start eating them.

I'm driving a car. The road is empty, I don't see any other cars. Music is playing on the radio - Hmm, I've never heard it before, interesting, pleasant... I pick up speed. The road smoothly turns to the right. Suddenly, a bus rushes straight at me from around the corner. I see the driver jerking the steering wheel - now to the left, now to the right. Desperately trying to avoid a collision, I turn the steering wheel to the side, but for some reason the car continues to drive straight into the bus, I press the brake... my foot sinks to the floor... there is simply no brake pedal! The bus is rapidly approaching me. Now I'm going to die! A-a-a-a...

I see everything as if in a fog... A multitude of memories replace each other in front of me, like a movie... I see a woman, a living being! I go to her and call to attract her attention, she looks at me in fear and runs away from me in horror...

I'm walking down the street. I see a young couple trying to pry open a window with a crowbar. I yell at them, and the man looks up from what he's doing and turns in my direction. He lets out a scream and pulls a revolver from his belt. With a trembling hand, he points the revolver at me and fires (BOOM!), the bullet hits me in the stomach... For some reason, I don't feel pain. In shock, I look down and see a hole right in my stomach, but there's no blood flowing. Instead, I see worms and insects crawling out of the hole in my stomach. I see flesh hanging off my body in lumps, hanging only by my skin. I look back at the couple. The woman is yelling at the man, pointing at me. She's saying something, but I can't understand her, as if she's speaking an alien language... They start running away from me...

I'm walking down the street past the living dead, and they ignore me. They don't growl at me. They don't look at me. It's like I don't exist... Walking towards the horde of the dead. I try to stop, but my body won't listen to me. I get closer and closer to their rotting bodies, I try to call for help, but all that comes out is a cold groan. My body keeps moving deeper and deeper into this horde against my will. Then I get to the middle, surrounded by rotting dead. I feel this is the end...

I'm scared and I have a strong feeling that I'm being watched and followed. I take one of the objects I took from the table in the apartment out of my pocket and throw it on the ground in front of me. The object rose into the air, began to stretch out and turned into some kind of long, thick worm, painted in a rainbow. The worm curled up into a figure eight and this figure eight just spins in the air. And again that voice... - Ultimatum of pain... Now the eyes of the whole world will be glued to this place. Run! I run back to the apartment. I check if the keys are in place. All this time I'm very nervous from the feeling of being followed. What should I do? I run out into the street. It's dark. Some strange darkness that appeared in the middle of the day...

(Trrrr-r-r-r... Ding, Ding...) I wake up from the sharp ringing of the alarm clock. I get out of my sleeping bag and get ready for the coming day. I open the can, not even looking at its label. More dog food... I heat it up on the fire. I finish breakfast, grab my shotgun, load the last four rounds and start the day...

I'm sneaking down the street, past a kindergarten, trying to take my eyes off the stumbling children... A small drugstore, I'm inside. I fill my pockets with small candies and soda in aluminum cans, I can go on...

I sneak a peek into the window of a small trailer, strangely, it seemed smaller from the outside... I see a man's corpse on the floor with his head blown open by a gunshot, blood mixed with hair and brains on the ceiling and walls, empty whiskey bottles scattered around the corpse, the corpse has a revolver in his hands. Poor guy, he got drunk and shot himself in the head... I try to open the window... It's locked... I push the frame up with all my might, I hear the window frame crack, Hrrrr... It finally opens. I climb into the window and reach for the gun, as soon as I'm about to grab it, the alarm goes off in the trailer. I grab the gun, rush to the door and run outside. Hundreds of zombies are approaching from the woods. I go out along the road to an old motel. More zombies appear, and I can't find the exit. I run to the nearest building and I try to open all the doors in a row, they are all locked, I run back, some stairs up... I pull the bolt on the gun (BOOM, BOOM, BOOM, BOOM, Klats, Klits...). Damn it, I'm out of bullets... I take out the revolver, aim at the nearest dead man stumbling on the stairs. (Klats, Klats..). I throw the gun, take out the screwdriver and start delivering blow after blow. ONE. TWO. THREE... I kill him when they reach the top of the stairs. TWENTY THIRTEEN. FOURTEEN... The stairs below are littered with corpses. My lungs are about to burst out. The screwdriver breaks... I look at the stairs. Two dozen zombies are crawling up the dead bodies. A hundred dead at the bottom of the stairs. I fall to the ground and close my eyes...

<RGB:0,0.5,1> Helicopter <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> I hear the sound of a helicopter mixed with machine gun fire. Hundreds of bullets tear apart the bodies of the dead in seconds. Confused, I look up at the sky and see the helicopter flying around me, then landing in the parking lot of a motel. I jump from the 2nd floor and run towards the helicopter. I see five people in full military gear, they point their guns at me and shout - Stop or we open fire! I stop in place and raise my hands. A man in a chemical protection suit appears from the helicopter. He approaches me and asks me to undress so he can check me for infection. I comply. He checks me from top to bottom for even the smallest scratches. Then he steps back, looks at the people with guns and tells them, - All clear. Then he tells me to get dressed. A man in a beret and in a mask, asks me if I'm okay. I just nod my head. - Infected! one of the soldiers screams. The man grabs my arm and throws me into the helicopter, the soldiers open fire on the dead. We take off... The soldiers say they are from the US Army, I scream at them, asking - where the hell were they when we were dying here?! In response, they say that for the past 3 months they did everything possible to save as many people as possible, but the virus was hitting so fast that there was no way to save everyone. In shock, I ask if there is anyone left... A moment later, he tells me that they managed to make a vaccine before the virus spread so far so that it could not spread further. But they could not do anything for those already infected. I fall out of my chair. I am not alone... Then he says that I look hungry and hands me an army dry meal. I eat it so fast that I almost swallow my tongue. Then they hand me a warm cup of coffee and as I drink it, tears stream down my face. One of the soldiers puts his hand on my shoulder and tells me that everything is going to be okay now and that I should get some rest as we have a long flight until we get back to Fort Knox. The adrenaline subsides and my stomach feels full, and I feel like I'm going to sleep for a week. I lean back in my seat and fall asleep to the sound of the helicopter... (Ding, Ding, Ding)... My alarm clock is ringing...
It's a pity that it was just a dream.

I'm driving past the third checkpoint in the city. It's strange, instead of descents and ascents in a pine forest, I saw a strange, unnatural place. There was a lake, next to a road with poplars growing along the edges. The mountains were a couple of kilometers from this place. I see men sawing these poplars and felling them right on the road. I can't understand where I am. I walk further along the road, discover residential buildings and streets, and remember that this place is in West Point. I call my father to pick me up. I go into some store, and when I come out, there are completely different houses and streets in front of me. What city am I in? I feel anxious and uncomfortable at all. I approach two guys who are sitting on a bench and talking. I sit down next to them. They don't notice me and continue talking about something. I hear the words of one of them. - If you don't know how to communicate in this city, then you will have a very, very hard time...

...A beautiful forest lake, there are many of them in Knox County. It is about five hundred by two hundred meters in size, and in the middle there are two small islands. There are several boats with fishermen on the lake. Suddenly, right in the middle, near the islands, a funnel began to form in the sky, which quickly grew into a tornado. The fishermen began to row to the shore in a panic. When the tornado touched the water surface, it quickly began to fill with water. The tall pines stretched out along the banks began to bend strongly from the wind and even break.

I enter an elevator with strangers. The elevator is quite large, and there are about ten of us in it. We start going down, and the elevator starts shaking violently. Some man found the lever and pulled it... The elevator suddenly started falling down. We fell hard, painfully. Right at the moment of impact with the bottom of the shaft, literally a millimeter away, to the right of my right leg, a meter-long piece of reinforcement came out. I almost broke my leg. We start removing pieces of the destroyed elevator floor, then digging the ground at the bottom of the elevator shaft. We dug up new school supplies: pens, pencils, rulers... It's all strange...

My birthday has come. My friend and I are alone in my grandmother's apartment. I washed myself, and then my friends came, and it was as if they had sailed in on a motorboat. I see how the motorboat began to sink to the bottom, and I dived after it. I realize that I am in a room, and there is waist-deep water everywhere. I open the closet doors, see that the water has not yet reached it, the books are dry. I remembered that I am naked. I immediately found a blue T-shirt, but for some reason it is very tight, and I can’t find the bottom of the T-shirt. Then my grandmother, grandfather, his sister and some young woman with a big belly (pregnant) appear in the doorway of the apartment. They entered, I was glad that my grandfather walks and talks well. Everyone went to the kitchen, and I went to another room to finally find shorts. Mom, as it turned out, was already standing there and looking them. But all in vain, they can't be found. A pregnant girl came up and complained that the music was too loud. I went to the kitchen to fix it. In the kitchen, everyone was sitting at the table. It was a strange feeling that there were a lot of people... But I couldn't remember anyone, the people were unfamiliar to me. I turned the radio knob to make it quieter...

Four men and three women, and I with them, are in a building that looks like a fortress or a castle. We are locked in a cell, constantly thinking about how to open the door. Our strength is running out, we have been in the cell for a very long time. And then, after another attempt, the heavy iron door opened. I decide to look through the barred window and see that a group of ghost soldiers is quickly moving towards the building. They look terrifying - faceless, black phantoms, from which darkness spreads. I turn my gaze back to the cell, but the people who were with me in it are no longer there, they are already moving further down the corridor, hoping to leave this damned place. And as soon as I start walking towards the exit, this black creature appeared and possessed me...

I find myself in a place unknown to me, but I understand that it is very far away, not even on planet Earth. I go down to a lake with bright turquoise water. I decide to dive in and swim. I dive into the water, and feel that I can't come up. I can easily stick my hands out of the water, and my head seems to be resting against an invisible ceiling, but this doesn't bother me, I can breathe freely underwater. In the reservoir itself, the water is very clear and fresh, and there are a lot of fish swimming... I decide to dive deeper and immediately regret it. Some unknown force pulls me into the depths. It was getting darker and colder. Now there are no fish swimming in the water, but only glowing creatures that look like fireflies. Panic sets in... Somehow I find myself on the shore again...

A strange place. A cramped room, a very low ceiling, you have to move around crouched. Two doors, both locked with bolts made of thick black boards. The boards are cold, wet and slippery to the touch. I try to move the bolt, nothing works, my hands slide along the surface. Something sticky on my palms...

I'm locked in a multi-room apartment with a bunch of different comrades in misfortune. There's trash, dust and darkness all around. Everyone's afraid of each other. It's not surprising - there are one or two plastic humanoids with us, invented to kill the living. I miraculously survive a fight with one of them. I'm hiding. Suddenly, someone grabs my hand and drags me to the balcony. It turns out to be some kind of elf. I open a pack of cigarettes and, struggling with wild stress, take a drag. Suddenly the phone rings. Quiet!!! The robot will hear! A female voice in a language unknown to me says something important, but I don't understand... I remember that before I found myself in the unfortunate apartment, I met some elf. I unexpectedly become a valuable asset of national importance. The elf has already self-destructed through the hole between the sofa and the wall. They lead me to the kitchen. I look around, the robots are not dozing, and their function has not yet been fulfilled. I am afraid all the time, very afraid. In the kitchen I calm down a little, it seems that one of the leaders has settled here. I doze off, sitting at the table, and feel a touch. I open my eyes - we are being carried out. They are rescuers! The evacuation is already in full swing on the balcony, we are lined up. Everyone is jumping. The still undeciphered call from the invisible interlocutor elevated me to the rank of the target of the operation. I stand in the doorway, watch others jump, they push me from behind. I clarify. - Should I jump too? I receive an affirmative answer and am about to jump down. However, I still do not have a parachute. I joke that I can already happily fly down for 10 minutes just like that. In general, I put on the parachute, receive the command to pull the ring in 10 seconds and jump. I think that no one gave instructions ... I pull, pull, pull, but not this and not there. Despite the fact that I had to evacuate from the balcony, I see the world below from a bird's eye view. And this world is approaching very quickly, but the parachute still does not open. I do not have time to feel the charm of free fall ... I land in a rice field, knee-deep in muddy water. Everyone who was with me in the apartment is also here nearby, contrary to the laws of physics. While we wait for the others, I intend to visit one of the 5-6 wooden cabins standing nearby. The first is covered with bleach, and I am barefoot. In the second, a cat with dead ginger kittens. In the third, a gray cat, and living kittens. In others, people. I decide to remove the ginger ones and carry out my plan, but the cartoonish shaking cat has already removed the kittens and cleared the field of activity. I did not succeed, because it is cramped, and there are cobwebs on all sides ...

I'm with my relatives, visiting an old grandfather, whom I don't know at all, but he's strikingly similar to a man named Tony Bits. We were walking around his garden plot, so to speak. Grandpa took a watering can and started watering crystals on the ground that resembled ordinary ice - about ten centimeters thick, but the ice doesn't melt. He invited us into the house, to the table. It's kind of shabby inside. The kitchen is shaped like a standard trailer - long and narrow. There's no ceiling in the kitchen - you can immediately see the roof of the house. Several wooden logs are hanging on the walls. Everyone at the table poured themselves some tea. Grandpa stands with his feet on the bench and takes a log off the wall. It turned out that milk was stored inside. Grandpa added milk to each log's tea, then hung the log back on the wall. I'm sitting at the table, completely perplexed, how is this possible...

Some family is driving my parents and me around the city. A few kilometers from the city, in the area of the mountain slopes, I notice a huge ash column that simply hangs over the city. The driver said that three volcanoes have awakened in the surrounding mountain ranges. We turn off to the large Sunstar motel and drive up the street, cross another street, drive a little more and stop. Six of us get out of the car: me, dad, mom, and the girl with her parents. It turned out that the girl had lost something, I don’t understand what exactly, they started looking, they looked in the car, but they never found anything. They lit a big fire, started burning trash, I don’t know why. It turns out that I’m at Muldraugh Elementary School, only the number of floors was several times larger, and the layout of the building was the same. I wander around the school, the school turns out to be practically empty. And suddenly something terrible begins. A very fast a guy runs and shouts at me: Run!!! A few meters away from him, doors in offices open and a crowd of bald, screaming freaks in orange clothes run in my direction. Music immediately starts playing in my head. Moving along the floors, we run from them, the crowds of psychos have almost caught up. Rhythmic music in my head dilutes the fear somewhat...

Evening. I'm sitting in a stranger's car, in the front seat, I realize that I'm going in a taxi, I don't know where. The music is playing quite loudly in the car. Suddenly, a woman's scream is heard from behind. - Turn the music down. The driver turned down the volume. Again, a woman's voice. - Even quieter. The driver turned the volume down almost completely. I decide to turn around and see what kind of woman is yelling. When I turned around, I saw the car - it was a limousine, not a taxi, and in the back seat was an old friend of mine whom I hadn't seen for several years. A feeling of joy appears. - Sofia, is that you? She remembered me, recognized me. We hug each other in a friendly manner.

Evening. I'm sitting in a stranger's car, in the front seat, I realize that I'm going in a taxi, I don't know where. The music is playing quite loudly in the car. Suddenly, a man's voice is heard from behind. - Turn the music down. The driver turned the volume down. Again, a man's voice. - Even quieter. The driver turned the volume down almost completely. I decide to turn around and see what kind of man is yelling. When I turned around, I saw the car - it was a limousine, not a taxi, and in the back seat was an old friend of mine whom I hadn't seen for several years. A feeling of joy appears. - Alexander, is that you? He remembered me, recognized me. We hug each other in a friendly manner.

I am holding a piece of transparent white stone in my hands, with dark burgundy veins visible inside. I am amazed at the beauty of this stone. A person I know well is showing it to me. I see that these are not just candles, but some special candles for magical practices. I go up to this woman to ask where she bought them. And she tells me, pointing to this office building, that there's a store up there. I look there, and one of the windows is barred, but not with an ordinary window grille, but with a very small one, that is, through which almost no light passes. It seems extremely strange to me. But I go inside. <LINE> <LINE> As soon as I enter, I realize that I'm in a long-abandoned, dilapidated building. And then, from behind the rubble of the first floor stairwell, two monsters started climbing towards me... <LINE> <LINE> I run outside in horror. And my gaze immediately shifts to the place where the woman stood and sold candles. It is surrounded by some zombies! <LINE> <LINE> I run down the steps, bypassing this crowd of monsters. I have two carts in my hands, which must cling to each other. I understand that I can only escape in one way - by clinging to Natasha, who for some reason is riding past on a bicycle. <LINE> <LINE> We break away and reach her house. Which is completely different from her current house. But for some reason I am no longer with Natasha, but with either Olga or someone else. And we understand that some kind of invasion of monsters has begun throughout the world. <LINE> <LINE> We enter the house, and there Natasha is going down the stairs with someone and she is completely indifferent to what is happening. It is very strange, as if she was zombified. We went up to another floor and began to look at what is happening below, from the window on the landing. And there below, aliens are taking everyone who leaves the house. But they do not look like monsters - they were just a crowd of strange people. <LINE> <LINE> And now I am with Natasha again.We decided to try to get out of the house. We go down... <LINE> <LINE> We are lying under some bush. We hid. We see how huge screens on the street are broadcasting what is happening in the world. First they show some man - a politician. One of the main ones. The aliens did something terrible to him. Then they show how all newborns are now branded - they put a round sign with a strange pattern inside on the right buttock. After that I understand that I am simply being dragged into sleep... <LINE> <LINE> I wake up from the fact that one of the aliens has found me. Natasha is not nearby. Oddly enough, he looks like an ordinary human guy. He leads me somewhere. We walk, and I think that a meteorite fell, and aliens came after it. And for me it is logical and real! Following him, I make some kind of table in my head. I think that when I fill it out, the dream will end, but I only manage to fill in two fields in the table. <LINE> <LINE> We continue walking down the street, there is a restaurant ahead, large round tables under the open sky. I stopped next to a man. He called me over, and the one who was leading me said nothing. This man from the restaurant gave me his glass of something light to finish - it looks like champagne. But after drinking, I don't feel the taste. Then he gave me a small stemmed glass. There is a scarlet liquid in it. It shimmers with different shades. I think it is liqueur... now it will be delicious. The liquid turned out to be disgusting - some kind of bitter-salty, with an incomprehensible aftertaste...",with an incomprehensible aftertaste...",with an incomprehensible aftertaste...

<RGB:0,0.5,1> Helicopter <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> I hear the sound of a helicopter mixed with machine gun fire. Hundreds of bullets tear apart the bodies of the dead in seconds. Confused, I look up at the sky and see the helicopter flying around me, then landing in the parking lot of a motel. I jump from the 2nd floor and run towards the helicopter. I see five people in full military gear, they point their guns at me and shout - Stop or we open fire! I stop in place and raise my hands. A man in a chemical protection suit appears from the helicopter. He approaches me and asks me to undress so he can check me for infection. I comply. He checks me from top to bottom for even the smallest scratches. Then he steps back, looks at the people with guns and tells them, - All clear. Then he tells me to get dressed. A man in a beret and in a mask, asks me if I'm okay. I just nod my head. - Infected! one of the soldiers screams. The man grabs my arm and throws me into the helicopter, the soldiers open fire on the dead. We take off... The soldiers say they are from the US Army, I scream at them, asking - where the hell were they when we were dying here?! In response, they say that for the past 3 months they did everything possible to save as many people as possible, but the virus was hitting so fast that there was no way to save everyone. In shock, I ask if there is anyone left... A moment later, he tells me that they managed to make a vaccine before the virus spread so far so that it could not spread further. But they could not do anything for those already infected. I fall out of my chair. I am not alone... Then he says that I look hungry and hands me an army dry meal. I eat it so fast that I almost swallow my tongue. Then they hand me a warm cup of coffee and as I drink it, tears stream down my face. One of the soldiers puts his hand on my shoulder and tells me that everything is going to be okay now and that I should get some rest because we have a long flight until we get back to Fort Knox. The adrenaline subsides and my stomach feels full, and I feel like I'm going to sleep for a week. I lean back in my seat and fall asleep to the sound of the helicopter... (Ding, Ding, Ding)... My alarm clock is ringing...
Hmm. I had an unusual dream...

<RGB:0,0.5,1> Helicopter <LINE> <RGB:1,1,1> Some invisible powerful creatures caught me to play their game. They caught me and started placing me in different spaces... I'm floating on a barge where a concert for the dead is taking place this year. I have to host it with some man, like a master of ceremonies. The man gave all the spectators plasticine robots and they started chewing them, but it turned out that the concert was just a cover, and that all these people were gathered here so that there would be an opportunity to climb around their houses, where funerals are taking place. I get out of the closet, people are everywhere in the house, all sad, in black, there is a coffin. I find a ring in the agreed place, and climb into a garbage bag, everyone behind me, of course, shouts - How did you get in here!?!?, and I'm already on the other side of town, tumbling into someone's window. In the end, I collect everything and go back the same way to the barge, the man leading, suddenly throws himself at the wall and destroys everything, I find myself on the shore, together with a huge white moose in a white T-shirt with yellow stripes on the sleeves. The moose is molded from plastic or something similar, and behind me there is a small toy boat. I walk along the shore, thinking where to go next - this moose is clearly not an advisor. I return to the boat, take it in my hands, and it turned out to be an exact small copy of that barge. On the wall where the man jumped, there was a small silhouette of him carved on a tree. He is full-length and points his finger somewhere. I look where he points his finger. It turns out that in that direction there is a residential area and smoke is rising from some building. I walk towards the houses, the moose with me. I approach a four-story building with smoke, I understand that it is a school, it is locked and there is panic. The moose and I climb up the fire escape almost to the very top. The roof is on fire. Through the windows I see that the kids are wearing school uniforms - white tracksuits with yellow stripes. I tell the moose - It's your turn, come on, dude, you have a task! And he stands there, looking at me. He's made of something, there are even fingerprints on him. I think - Idiot. I take his T-shirt off, put it on and out the window. The moose remains outside. I enter a room, like a circus arena, round. There is a meeting. Everyone is scared, everyone knows something. I jump out on stage, take the microphone and start talking. I entertain the audience a little, relax them, feel this excitement and at the same time I watch all the spectators, they are in the palm of my hand. One strange Mickey Mouse alerted me and a man who looks at me with horror and whispers something. I take him out on stage, give him a microphone and make him say in front of everyone what he knows. I calm him down. - Everyone is ours and everyone wants to know... He says to me. - You - it's you, the one! Who, I say, the one?? Well, the one we warned you about! It turns out that some man had been here before me and scared everyone, who set the roof on fire so that everyone would get scared and run away. Everyone was waiting for me. I remember that before the concert for the dead they explained to me that there was some man here who could destroy everyone if the doors closed.I need to neutralize it and prevent everything. What does it mean: if the doors close, they didn’t explain to me. I try to calm people down and carefully grab Mickey Mouse. I rip off his plush suit, there was another Mickey Mouse inside - as if alive, moving, looking at me, I rip off this suit too. There is another Mickey Mouse, only smaller. A couple more times and I get to the small battery-powered electric bug. Meanwhile, everything began to collapse. I disassemble the bug for spare parts and lose a lot of time. I begin to lead the frightened people out, and I see how in the distance, between schoolchildren in white suits, the same man who closes the doors flashed. He climbed into a garbage bag after me in one of the houses... I followed him. ... ... A device was assembled from the found tools, with the help of which you can jump into some kindergarten, where I am a child, and he is a teacher. He knows that I am in one of the children, but he does not know which one. Everything is precisely calculated to pin him against the wall in a room filled with children's picture books. It turned out as a result of the conversation that he was told that I am an enemy, that everyone near me dies when I open the doors, and that he needs to save people from me.. They gathered all the people, put them in the elevator and went down to where it is safe. As soon as everyone got out of the elevator and the doors began to close, some old man flew in on a helicopter and said that we were great, we did the job. I understand that the elevator doors opened in front of me, and now they will close in front of him, the man, and everything will explode. I hold the elevator doors, and the old man in the helicopter laughs. The man cries, everyone runs in different directions...",and now they will close in front of him, the man, and everything will explode. I hold the elevator doors, and the old man in the helicopter laughs. The man cries, everyone runs in different directions...",and now they will close in front of him, the man, and everything will explode. I hold the elevator doors, and the old man in the helicopter laughs. The man cries, everyone runs in different directions...

I'm standing next to a large metal pipe with a diameter of more than a meter - I'm standing above it and I see that its entire surface is bending as if the wall of the pipe is very thin, and there are many thin pipes in it that are constantly wriggling, bending and unbending in numerous right angles and intertwining with each other, I don't see thin pipes, I only see general outlines pushing through the thin wall of a large one. This is some kind of problem, it will be solved when the movement stops, I don't see the core of the problem, only the surface. Everything around is made of metal. Looking from above, I see a beautiful city made of red metal in the setting sun, the houses in it are constantly growing, going into the ground, changing their shape, it is constantly being built, there are no windows in the moving houses, they are metal monoliths, but I know that windows will appear. The closer to the center, the higher the buildings, the buildings in the center form a spire going up into the sky. I know for sure that I've been building this city since childhood, this city is a reflection of my life. Waking up I understand that any film can be considered as a dream of its author, even if there are no dreams in the plot, and the real cities in which we live are the collective dreams of their inhabitants.

I'm walking down the street. Everything seems to be fine, it's summer outside, bluish-white clouds are floating across the sky. And then I realize that I don't remember how I ended up here. My brain is in shock and starts working. I remember last night and how I went to bed. I realize that I'm sleeping - and this is a shock mixed with delight. I look around more carefully, trying to determine my feelings. The wind is blowing, giving my body a coolness. The shadow of the leaves sways on the asphalt. The sun blinds my eyes. I go up to a tree on the side of the road and start examining it. I touch it with my hands and feel the bark. The sensations are complete: hearing is a degree of reality, sight is reality, smell is reality, touch is reality. The world is modeled 100%% correctly.

I come to the city to see my girlfriend, I go to her house, everything seems to be as usual. But I have a very strong desire to see her, I run into the house, go into her apartment, it is empty, there is no one, I am enveloped in panic, where is my beloved? I start running around her apartment and loudly calling her name, I run into her room and there I call and call her, but in vain. Then I go out into the street completely depressed and, next to the house, on a bench, sits an elderly woman. I go up to her, look her straight in the eyes and recognize my girlfriend in her. Tears well up in our eyes, we sit down next to each other, she is old, and I am at my age, and we begin to remember those moments when we were together, we laugh and regret the lost time ...

An ordinary winter evening, I'm going to meet some friends, but I only have 50 dollars, and I still need to get there and back. I meet an old friend of mine. We're walking near my house, in a neighboring area, talking about something, suddenly something happened next to us on the road with the police cars, I don't really understand what exactly... Both cars got stuck on the side of the road, but didn't stop, but slowly tried to get out. Suddenly a man and a woman get out of the car, and the man throws a glass bottle at the police car - an accurate hit. Then everyone jumped out of the cars, and the man who threw the bottle took out a rifle and started shooting randomly. I start filming all this action on a video camera. Very soon this Rambo with a gun notices me and shoots in my direction. I start running away, running and shaking with fear, my legs are like cotton wool, I can hardly move. He runs after me and shoots at me. I run through the alleys, confusing him. Adrenaline is at its limit. I run up to the store... it seems he has fallen behind, I see a police patrol, I run up to them and tell them what happened, they call an ambulance, it turns out I have a wound, and blood is flowing heavily from my back in two places. The ambulance arrives, they put me on a stretcher. The doctor says - You will live!

A huge round room. In the middle, in the floor, there is an equally huge, round and deep empty well, going far, far down. At the very edge of the well, people in dark clothes are squatting, with hoods on their heads. They are looking down. One of them turns in my direction and screams at the top of his lungs. - One shot himself!!! And immediately jumps down. The others sitting on the edge begin to jump down. I see how they fly down and crash into the bottom. With a delay of a couple of seconds, I hear the sounds of bodies hitting the metal bottom of the well...

I'm with my boyfriend. We're in an ancient castle, at war. We're dressed in armor, holding bows. I'm hugging him, and he has a knife in his chest. Two wounds, each of which is fatal, and I pull out the knife and try to cover the wounds with my hands. The blood flows in spurts, drips onto my hands, onto the floor. There's an incredible amount of blood. And it doesn't stop. At some point, I realize that I was the one who struck. He dies, I stop covering the wounds and hug him tightly. At that moment, our troops burst into the castle, and that's how they find me - on my knees, hugging a dead enemy...

I enter the restaurant and sit down at the table. The waitress comes and asks for my order. I ask for a glass of water with lemon and the daily special menu. The waitress writes it down in her notebook and leaves. I look around the place - very elegant, with red curtains, marble floors and black furniture. The waitress returns soon with my dish. She places the plate on the table, lifts the stainless steel lid, hot steam comes out. My mouth is watering when I see the best pair of delicious denim shorts. I take a fork and knife, start cutting small pieces and eat it like a thick steak from delight ... I wake up, not breathing, with half a pillow in my mouth ...

I see myself surrounded by dark, faceless figures, the dark figures trying to grab me like the undead that surround me outside of my dreams. They cling to me, trying to pull me into the ground through my bed. I panic and they start turning their heads so that they are facing away from me and reveal a large open mouth filled with sharp, crooked teeth. I manage to break free, waking up from the nightmare, drenched in sweat, sitting up on my bed. I look away just to realize that I am still not in the nightmare with the dark figure reaching out to me, saying it is okay, we mean no harm. Back to sleep. I refuse to go back to sleep and instead reach out to it and feel a sense of comfort. I finally wake up relieved, not understanding the purpose of the dream or its meaning.

All I can see is the sky as I feel myself falling, I feel the air rushing around my body and hear it howling in my ears. I try to scream in fear, anticipating the pain of hitting the ground, but it doesn't happen, I just fall endlessly into nothingness. For a split second I feel like I'm landing hard, only to wake up with a pain in my back.

I'm in the bathroom, taking off all my gear and putting it on the washing machine. Then I turn on the shower - warm water! Taking a shower with warm water at this time makes me happier, it's like a birthday present! I hear a knock on the door after I finish washing myself... and then I realize that my gun, clothes and everything I was laying on the washing machine are gone. The doors open abruptly, and after a while I feel like fangs are tearing my intestines apart...

For some reason I am in an abandoned factory with a team of 8 seekers equipped with torches. (I am one of them too) I don't know what I am doing here or what we are looking for, we are getting ready to go down this metal - square spiral staircase 3 by 3 meters wide, which I think leads to the basement. We start going down, down and down the stairs. When I started to think that it is bottomless, since we have gone very deep, but we have not reached the end yet. Suddenly I hear a terrible scream from one of the seekers, followed by a monstrous and terrible roar. Everyone, including me, started to instinctively run for their lives. I heard this thing climbing loudly and faster than us. For a short moment I glanced over my shoulder, hurrying up. It was so dark and all I saw was a large shadow figure chasing us. My heart started to beat ... It was hunting us down one by one. All I heard was the short screams of the captured and growling. I could hear the steps of the thing getting closer and closer to me and I could also feel the vibrations of the stairs. While I was so tired of choosing to live for so long, I began to think that this was the end before I saw the beginning of the stairs... I did it and for some reason my instincts told me to get out of the dark factory before breathing a sigh of relief. So I ran to the big open factory door 10-15 meters away and rushed outside, into the daylight, and also to the other three survivors.

I wake up in the clouds, everything is too light. Apparently very high. I see a tiled bridge going right on the clouds, it looks very ancient, but well preserved. Out of interest, I start walking along it, I start to see low columns, I enter an ancient temple, I have never seen such buildings before and because of this it looks unfinished. Memories of my parents creep into my head. Suddenly I felt like a child. At the end of the temple I see a party. I think - if I am a child, then I should go to my mother. As soon as I approach the crowd, the temple immediately collapses on me...

The halls are evenly spaced and numbered. The tiles are black on white, etched with an antiseptic. My steps sync easily with the tiled floor, as if the tiles themselves were meant for me alone. Absolute Darkness spreads around me, the only light coming from above. It seems to follow me as I walk, powerful enough to reach the foot of the doorways on either side. The further I walk, the colder the air becomes, and each step becomes faster than the last. Before I realize it, my breath has become opaque and foggy. I pick up the pace, trying to fight the cold, but it only gets worse. Each breath feels like an icy dagger, dripping moisture from my lungs. My heart is thundering now, the tiles an impossible gray blur. Without warning, the light goes out, my breathing quickens. I believe my heart has stopped...

I'm standing in a dark corridor, everything is in complete darkness. I feel the walls, and at the same moment, the edges of the walls begin to glow bright yellow. I understand that I'm standing at the crossroads of several corridors. I decide to go down one of them, not hoping to find anything. Suddenly, a rat runs out from around the corner. In an instant, it became gigantic, higher than the ceilings, which, as it turns out, do not exist. I run. It is chasing me! My vision changes, I no longer see what is in front of me, I see everything. Each corridor, a giant rat glowing golden-yellow, stepping on my heels, and myself, desperately seeking (seeking) salvation. The corridors form a simple labyrinth, with no entrance or exit. I run in horror. The walls are no longer clear, everything has become uneven, even, square. The rat running after me became a single line, bending at the junctions of the corridors. I myself became an ordinary blue square, running from a large yellow line that looked like a snake. I stop, because of extreme fatigue. The snake, already quite real, pounces on me. I don't have time to react. I am gone. I am in the emptiness of non-existence...

I'm walking through the desert and come across a canyon, inside it is a large mechanical structure like a box, supported by thin twisting scaffolding and a small bridge, this metal building is broken and battered, it looks like it could fall into the depths of the canyon at any moment. <LINE> <LINE> I use the small bridge to enter the box, the inside matches the outside, old, twisted, rusty metal. My attention is drawn to a strange hole in the wall, light is leaking from this hole, the light is not like the light of the sun, I venture through it and find myself standing in a square in front of a train station. Where am I? There were no train tracks leading to or from the box, there was no city or train track in the desert around the canyon. I am the only soul for miles.. I hear a bell ring, the doors to the station swing open and the square fills people... <LINE> <LINE> A woman comes up to me, dressed in a big green dress with a big hat to match the dress. I try to get answers from her. I wanted to know where we were, and then I saw her face, her skin made of fabric, it was white, lacy, with soft stripes running down her face and body, her plump lips with red lipstick. I don't remember her eyes, but I think they matched her dress. All these details... but her words made her ugly. I don't understand what she's saying to me, but I know she's being rude to me...

Pitch darkness all around, I crawl in search of light, praying to God for salvation, in this gloomy and cold world. I feel for matches, strike... a spark falls to the ground, and everything around is engulfed in flames. Now I can see, but the world that once was is now a distant memory...

I wake up in a fright, I look around, I look in the closet, I look everywhere, but I can't find a single one anywhere. I look out the window - no strays, no rotting flesh, just people going about their business. I don't understand how I end up in my old bed? I'm in my bunker. It took almost a year to create this place deep in the forest, away from all these walking dead. This must be a dream, a sick dream from the past. I need to wake up, I need to wake myself up with shock, I need to jump out the window and wake myself up with electricity! Oh, it hurts! The sidewalk - it hurts! Help me... I wake up in a hospital with bandages everywhere! I can't wake up from this dream! I press the call button for help. Where are the zombies, what's going on?! What do you mean, you don't understand what I'm talking about?! I won't calm down! I won't stop, let go! I break free and run out of the hospital. No, don't stop the car... I can't believe all the blood is pouring out of me! Stay away from me, go away, stop reaching for me, I don't need your help. NO... that's the last thing on my mind as the Zombies chew me up in my bunker in my sleep...

Wow! So this is a dream? This is one of the rare times I remember dreaming. I wonder what I can do in my dreams. I'm outside, sweet! I'm driving, wow! Now I want to go where the zombies are. Oh, how I want to apologize for them, I can! This is my dream. Okay, I'm going to get my trusty gun out. I'm going to kill them. Look at them all going down! It's so real! If only real life could feel this calm, it would be so easy. I just need to kill a few more, great! I look around, I think I'm home. Lucid dreaming gives me courage, that's for sure. Everything is fading, I must be waking up. I look at my feet. Everything is bloody and blurry. Was this a dream or am I really... Am I still dreaming?

I see a barn. I've seen this barn many times when I drive past it on my way to the grocery store. The barn door is always rattling, I don't know why. I don't want to go near it, it's scary. Week after week I pass by this barn. The door keeps shaking, rattling, wanting to break. I don't want it to open, I'm afraid of what's behind it. I can't help it, it needs to be kept closed! I try to tape the door, use wood glue, hammer nails, but nothing holds back the inevitable.... The door is about to open! I start to panic. The door finally falls apart. The light around me starts to dim. It's so cold!

Please turn off the music! I'm trying to concentrate. I have an exam to study for and I just can't study with all this noise! Can you hear me? STOP THE NOISE! Why don't they care about important things like grades and careers? It sounds like there's a party going on outside. Why throw a party in the middle of the week? I grab my books and go into my closet. I close the door and turn on the light, finally a quiet place. They never cared about my future. I won't let them take that away from me. I'll be more focused that I'll block out all the noise they make even at my closet door. Break in if you want, you won't convince me to help you with your selfish needs. Nothing you do can distract me from a happy and bright future. Nothing you do, nothing, nothing...

Be my valentine. I love you so much. You can have my liver, my pancreas, my intestines... Heck, you can have both my kidneys if you want. What about my lungs? Why not?! I love everything about you. Your droopy eyes and rotting teeth. Your peeling skin is so soft. I don't know why I never saw how magnificent you are before. I was supposed to give myself to you before, but now... It's supposed to be like this, the way nature made us... compatible. When we're happy together, I'll help you! I won't hold you back anymore. We'll love everyone together. Isn't that the real beauty of life - loving everyone? No discrimination? I can feel it, I'm in your arms. Thank you, thank you for accepting me. I'll be proud of you. You'll see, you'll see...
I'm a butterfly flying through Muldraugh. I see people hugging and kissing, smearing each other with red paint. I land on someone's head. I think it's me, but I'm covered in red paint too!
What a strange dream!

I wake up in a hospital - my body is tied to a bed, I see people and doctors running away through the window in the door. A moment later, one of the creatures catches up with a woman in a robe and devours her. Have they learned to run?! I hear multiple blows on the door, I feel cold sweat pouring down. I try to break free, but only roll over and fall. Turning towards the door, I see a terrifying-looking woman running towards me, with a torn face and lifeless eyes.

I'm in the attic of my house. I'm sitting on an old bed, looking at an old TV, in the player of which, lying on it, a VHS tape with a classic black-and-white horror film is inserted. Next to the player, on the TV, there are several tapes - that means I'm having a movie marathon. On my bed there is an extension cord with the wires from the TV plugged into it. Everything would be fine, but I remember that in this attic, on the opposite side from the exit, a little further from the TV, right in front of the window, there is a sculpture of an angel, and it looks somewhere to the left, holding its hands in a prayer pose. The body of the sculpture is turned in my direction. Suddenly I realize that the sculpture will haunt me - if they turn away ... <LINE> <LINE> This is not just a sculpture, it is also an animatronic! Cyclic movement of the head - first there is its slow rise upward, then a slow and smooth blinking, the next movement of the head down, blinking again... everything repeats itself in a circle... <LINE> <LINE> I remember that there are mannequins standing to the left of the wall behind the TV, quite a few of them, about six. The angel statue is now looking in their direction. All of them are animated!!! They have no faces, they are all white. First they make a smooth bow to each other, and then they make some movements with their hands. <LINE> <LINE> - How cool they are animated! <LINE> <LINE> All the movements are smooth and beautiful, as if they were alive. Clearly the work of a master. <LINE> <LINE> I look at the sculptures for a while, the plot on the TV - from a normal dialogue, switches to a moment that is alarming for the plot. My gaze turns away for a moment to the bed I am sitting on - the extension cord has disappeared somewhere. I look at the face of the statue... it looks in my direction again - the same movements, raising its head, blinking... I start to worry a little... I hear the sound of it turning off... the TV screen goes dark. In the hands of the statue I see an extension cord with disconnected wires. <LINE> <LINE> I call my parents, it seems they are nearby... <LINE> <LINE> With a frightened intonation, I tell them what just happened to me. <LINE> <LINE> They listen attentively. I point to the statue, its head turned somewhere to the left, its eyes are closed, its hands are in a prayer pose... neither the statue nor the mannequins make any movements... they are just standing figures. <LINE> <LINE> I look at the bed - on it lies the same extension cord with the wires pulled out. From the parents' side I hear laughter...
